scripts.desktop:build: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.main.config.ts && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.preload.config.ts && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.revamp.config.ts
scripts.desktop:start: npm run desktop:build && node node_modules/electron/cli.js apps/desktop
scripts.web:build: npm run ui:revamp:build && npm --workspace @tlc/web run build
scripts.web:start: npm run web:build && cross-env TLC_WEB_MODE=sample node apps/web/dist/server.js
scripts.web:start:live: npm run web:build && cross-env TLC_WEB_MODE=azure-cli node apps/web/dist/server.js
scripts.desktop:legacy:start: npm run desktop:build && cross-env TLC_UI_MODE=legacy node node_modules/electron/cli.js apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config apps/desktop/vite.revamp.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:5174 && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --watch --config apps/desktop/vite.main.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:5174 && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --watch --config apps/desktop/vite.preload.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:5174 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 node node_modules/electron/cli.js apps/desktop"
scripts.test:smoke:desktop: npm run desktop:build && playwright test tests/e2e/desktop/preview.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.test:smoke:revamp:desktop: npm run desktop:build && playwright test tests/e2e/revamp/desktop.spec.ts --config playwright.revamp.config.ts --reporter=line
scripts.test:smoke:revamp: npm run desktop:build && playwright test tests/e2e/revamp --config playwright.revamp.config.ts --reporter=line
scripts.test:smoke:live: npm run desktop:build && cross-env TLC_RUN_LIVE_SMOKE=1 playwright test tests/e2e/desktop/live.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.validate:major: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:smoke:desktop
scripts.phase0:check: npm run check:structure && npm run preflight && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
